purpose: Teach: 精通/バネ/急上昇/弁理/全編/特段/ジャッジ/発進

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界に精通した方を採用しましょう
lines.en: Let's hire someone with real industry expertise.
lines.style: Decisive and forward-moving. Clear instruction, no hesitation. Crisp consonants on the key words. Posture is upright, commanding but not unkind. Expecting agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。バネのある人材を歓迎します
lines.en: Yes. I welcome someone with that kind of drive.
lines.style: Agreeable and engaged. A beat of affirmation on the opening. Warm but professional. Slight nod in the voice — not just compliance but genuine backing.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 株価急上昇の要因を分析しましょう
lines.en: Let's look at what drove the stock price up so sharply.
lines.style: Focused, analytical. Lean forward slightly in tone. Curious but methodical — not casual. Pace steady and controlled. No room for vagueness here.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。弁理士に商標相談を依頼します
lines.en: Yes. I'll have us consult with a patent attorney on the trademark side.
lines.style: Efficient and specific. Taking note, thinking ahead. Confident in the next step. Delivers like someone already moving to the phone. Warm undertone beneath the action.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 提案書の全編を見直しましょう
lines.en: Let's go through the entire proposal again.
lines.style: Measured but firm. This is not a suggestion. Slight pause before 'entire' — emphasizing thoroughness. Tone is expectant. Professional calm that carries weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。特段の予算配分を検討します
lines.en: Yes. I'll look at how we allocate the budget for this.
lines.style: Attentive and responsive. Taking ownership without fuss. Practical, grounded tone. The kind of yes that means 'I'm already on it.' Slight warmth beneath the professionalism.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プロジェクトのジャッジを公平にしましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we judge this project fairly.
lines.style: Calm but with quiet conviction underneath. This matters. Even pace, no hurry. Thoughtful — not lecturing, but setting a standard. Open eye-contact level.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新キャンペーンの発進日を決めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll get the launch date locked in for the new campaign.
lines.style: Decisive closure. Clean, confident delivery. Slight lift at the end — moving toward completion. Practical and ready. The tone of someone wrapping up and moving forward.
